MRW stands for Maximum Design Ramp Weight. It refers to the maximum permissible weight for ground maneuvering, which includes the weight of taxi and run-up fuel. This weight is limited by the aircraft's structural strength and airworthiness requirements. It is also known as Maximum Design Taxi Weight (MTW). For A320-200 models, specific MRW values vary by weight variant (WV), ranging from 66,400 kg (146,387 lb) for WV006 to 78,400 kg (172,842 lb) for WV015 and WV017. For A320neo models, MRW values range from 70,400 kg (155,205 lb) for WV056 to 79,400 kg (175,047 lb) for WV054 and WV055.
